In [[137 ABY]], a '''meeting''' of [[Codru-Ji]] clan leaders was called by [[clan chief]] [[Rikkar-Du]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] was attempting to annex the Codru-Ji [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]] and had approached Rikkar-Du to unite the clans under his rule. Rikkar-Du refused and called a meeting of the clan leaders to discuss opposition to the Sith's machinations.<ref name="Legacy 13" />
